Delegate.description: A person at or behind the conference: organiser, volunteer, speaker or attendee. A first name alone is not an identity.

Session.description: One slot on the programme: a talk, panel or workshop, whoever runs it.

SessionRole.description:
Who does what in a session: presents it, chairs it, or sits on its panel.
Chairing a session is not presenting it.

Pairing.description: Two delegates paired for the event: a host looks after a newcomer as buddy, or they share a hotel room.

TravelClaim.description: A request to be paid back for travel. claimant spent the money, booker made the booking, approver signs the claim off.

RoomBooking.description: A venue room held for the event: how many seats, and whether it is held, confirmed or released.

questions.q: Who is the chair of Quiet Networks?
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Session)-[:chair]->(n1:Delegate) WHERE n0.session_title = 'Quiet Networks' RETURN n1.full_name AS full_name

questions.speaker: amara_n
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Delegate)-[:chaired]->(n1:Session) WHERE id(n0) = $speaker RETURN n1.session_title AS session_title

questions.speaker: amara_l
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Delegate)-[:roommate]->(n1:Delegate) WHERE id(n0) = $speaker RETURN n1.full_name AS full_name
MATCH (n0:Delegate)-[:buddied]->(n1:Delegate) WHERE n0.full_name = 'Thandiwe Mokoena' RETURN n1.full_name AS full_name

questions.q: How many travel claims are there?
Is there a record of receipts for the claims of Siobhan Doherty?
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Delegate)<-[:claimant]-(n1:TravelClaim) WHERE n0.full_name = 'Siobhan Doherty' RETURN coalesce(n1.receipts_attached, false) AS receipts_attached

questions.q: Were receipts attached to the claims of Keiko Watanabe?
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Delegate)<-[:claimant]-(n1:TravelClaim) WHERE n0.full_name = 'Keiko Watanabe' RETURN n1.receipts_attached AS receipts_attached

questions.q: How much were the claims Amara Nwosu approved?
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Delegate)<-[:approver]-(n1:TravelClaim) WHERE n0.full_name = 'Amara Nwosu' RETURN n1.amount_euros AS amount_euros

questions.q: Who booked the travel on my claims?
questions.speaker: siobhan
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Delegate)<-[:claimant]-(n1:TravelClaim)-[:booker]->(n2:Delegate) WHERE id(n0) = $speaker RETURN n2.full_name AS full_name

questions.q: How many seats does the Lantern Room booking have?
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:RoomBooking) WHERE n0.venue_room = 'Lantern Room' RETURN n0.seats AS seats

questions.q: Which rooms are booked, and what is their status?
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:RoomBooking) RETURN n0.venue_room AS venue_room, n0.status AS status

questions.q: What is the status of the taxi claim?
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:TravelClaim) WHERE n0.purpose CONTAINS 'taxi' RETURN n0.status AS status

questions.q: Who is the presenter of Tidal Energy Futures?
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Session)-[:presenter]->(n1:Delegate) WHERE n0.session_title = 'Tidal Energy Futures' RETURN n1.full_name AS full_name
MATCH (n0:Delegate) WHERE n0.full_name = 'Rafael Quispe' RETURN n0.phone AS phone

questions.q: Who is a panelist on Open Ledger Roundtable?
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Session)-[:panelist]->(n1:Delegate) WHERE n0.session_title = 'Open Ledger Roundtable' RETURN n1.full_name AS full_name

questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Delegate)-[:panel]->(n1:Session) WHERE id(n0) = $speaker RETURN n1.session_title AS session_title
